[[Image:River Akuum map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''River Akuum''' is a major waterway in [[Arad Doman]]. It flows out of the [[Mountains of Mist]] and flows north and west to its junction with the [[Dhagon]]. The city-state of [[Katar]] is located south of the river.
